items.title: File Widerspruch against rejection of disability pension
items.quote: Wer mit diesem Bescheid nicht einverstanden ist, kann ihn mit dem Widerspruch anfechten; dafür steht ab der Bekanntgabe ein Monat zur Verfügung.
items.computation: Letter dated/posted Wed 2027-09-29 by the pension insurance carrier (a social-law body, governed by § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X, not the AO). Deemed delivery = posting day + 4 calendar days (rule for letters posted on/after 1 Jan 2025) = Sun 2027-10-03. Unlike tax offices, non-tax authorities and social-law bodies do not shift the delivery day even if it falls on a weekend, so delivery stands at 2027-10-03. The one-month Widerspruch period runs from this event day and ends, per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, on the day in the following month bearing the same number: 2027-11-03 (Wednesday). That day is a normal working day in NRW (not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday), so no further shift under § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X is needed.
